name: New expense defaults to device local date and records creation time
description: The Add Expense form starts with the current local calendar date and the recent table displays added time.
steps: Sign in and open Add Expense
Inspect Date field without selecting any date
Create an expense and open Overview
Inspect Recent expenses date cell
expected: Date is preselected to the device's current local calendar day. The new expense has a readable added-at time below the date in Recent expenses.

name: Editing does not overwrite creation time
description: Editing an expense may change the expense date but preserves its original creation timestamp.
steps: Create a new expense and note its Recent Expenses added-at time
Edit the expense and update description and expense date
Return to Overview
expected: Expense date reflects edit, while original creation time stays the same.

name: Historical expenses render without fabricated times
description: Old records lacking createdAt remain visible without inventing a creation time.
steps: Open workspace with expenses saved before createdAt was introduced
Inspect Recent expenses list on mobile
Edit one historical expense
expected: Historical entries display their expense date without an invented time; editing does not add a fake creation timestamp.

name: Shared balances and parent ownership remain intact
description: Time metadata does not affect reimbursement calculations or access permissions.
steps: Parent A creates $200 expense at 50% share
Parent B creates $120 expense at 50% share
Inspect totals and actions
expected: Net Parent B owes Parent A $40. Each parent can edit only their own expenses; date/time remains visible.

name: Premium sidebar and mobile five-tab navigation
description: Five sections remain accessible on desktop and mobile with redesigned navigation and clean expense cards.
steps: Sign in and view dashboard
Check Overview Expenses Payments Report and Settings tabs on mobile
Add expense and examine recent expense card
Switch to tablet and desktop widths
expected: All navigation remains usable and financial information fits without horizontal page overflow.

name: Co-parent expense notifications and pending balances
description: Parent A sees Parent B's newly added expense in the bell menu; reading it persists and personal pending dues are displayed.
steps: Sign in with two linked parents in separate sessions
Parent B creates expense
Wait 30 seconds or refresh Parent A
Open notification bell and mark item read
Refresh and inspect pending amount
expected: Only the other parent gets the expense alert, marking read persists, and each account sees the correct amount they owe.

name: Mobile notification bell and responsive logo
description: At narrow phone widths the logo and header notification controls remain usable.
steps: Open the app at a 375px viewport
Inspect logo pending chip and bell
Open bell and view pending and awaiting amounts
expected: Header and notification panel fit phone width, with no horizontal overflow.

name: Sidebar logo and personalized user welcome
description: The CoParent logo and brand title are in the desktop sidebar, while the main header greets the signed-in user with their saved profile display name.
steps: Sign in with a test user and set a custom display name in My Profile
Open Overview and verify logo and brand in the left sidebar
Verify header reads Welcome back followed by saved profile name
Resize to tablet and mobile viewports and inspect navigation
expected: Desktop shows logo only in sidebar, header welcomes the correct signed-in parent, tablet rail retains brand icon, and narrow mobile header remains readable with bell and pending indicator.

name: Header aligns flush to viewport top and main content left edge
description: Header spans flush to the top and left outer content boundaries while its welcome text and notification controls retain comfortable inner padding.
steps: Sign in and inspect overview at desktop width
Check header top touches main content top and left edge aligns with sidebar boundary
Resize to 375px mobile and inspect top/left header edges
Check dashboard cards and notification bell are still accessible
expected: No external top or left whitespace around header, no horizontal overflow, and inner header elements remain readable at all widths.

name: Full width header and clean pages without redundant heading
covers: removal of page head title and subtitle
description: Header aligns edge-to-edge in main viewport with no outer gaps. Individual pages omit redundant header blocks but retain functional action buttons.
steps: Sign in and inspect desktop header right edge at 1440px
Open Overview, Expenses, Payments, Report, Settings, and expense form
Verify no .head page titles/subtitles are shown and Add Expense, Record Payment, and Print still work
Check 375px mobile layout for overflow
expected: Header is flush to right edge, no page-specific heading/subtitle appears, all essential buttons remain accessible, and mobile viewport remains clean.
